concept_title:
Scalar Product and Work Done
by Constant Force
latex_formula: W = F · d = F d cos θ
ncert_citation:
NCERT Class 11 Physics Part 1
Chapter 5, Section 5.2 - 5.3
ncert_core_rule:
Work is a scalar quantity equal
to dot product of force and
displacement. Zero if force, d,
or cos(theta) is zero.
author_book_nuance:
Normal and centripetal forces
do zero work on level ground
because theta = 90 degrees.
neet_trap_point:
Confusing sign of work: work is
negative when theta > 90 deg
(e.g. friction opposes motion).
